name: Breeze Canna PRO Live Resin Disposable | OG Kush
description: Experience the timeless classic that started it all with OG Kush's signature piney gas profile and complex earthy undertones. Featuring myrcene, limonene, and pinene terpenes, this legendary strain delivers the perfect balance of cerebral euphoria and physical relaxation that made it the foundation of modern cannabis.
